Name: JaurNaur's Cottage Core Stone Farmhouse
Author: jaurNaur
Description:
[color=#d9ead3][u][font=Arial][size=4]Stone Cottage Farmhouse for Content Patcher

[/size][/font][/u][size=3][font=Arial]This mod replaces the default farmhouse with a cute cottage-core stone house, which changes with each farmhouse upgrade.
NOW ABLE TO BE RECOLOURED AT ROBINS
Link for alternative textures version at bottom of description.

There are two versions, regular and mossy, please download and use only one[/font].

[font=Arial]To use, simply un-zip and place directly into your mods folder.[/font][/size][/color][size=3]
[/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][color=#fff2cc][b][u][i]Requires[/i]
[/u][/b]- Smapi
- Content Patcher[/color]

[color=#ead1dc][u][b][i]Suggested[/i]
[/b][/u]- A recolour mod that makes the world more muted or earthy, this is not necessary but will help my farmhouse blend in.
- No other farm house exterior mods as I am unsure how these will interact.
[/color]
[color=#cfe2f3][u][i][b]Extra Notes[/b][/i][/u]
- 1st stage farmhouse has some areas that are not walkable due to the game considering them to be walls/log store,
- 2nd and 3rd have a similar issue where the log store is now in the tower, so there will be visual issues when accessing it for late game reasons.
- 3rd stage farmhouse chimneys do not line up with smoke animation, however I was too far along when I realised.

This is my first attempt at creating a mod from scratch so please feel free to let know if there are any other issues.
[b][u][i]Currently working on a full farm building pack !! bare with <3
[/i][/u][/b]
